about_the_game:
Revolver Lillies is a top-down looter shooter featuring fast-paced battles, randomly generated weapons, and comic book inspired pixel-art visuals.

You play as Lily, a humble cowgirl, shooting and looting your way through a lawless frontier, bombing all the bad guys and banging all the bad girls! Out here, violence is always the solution! Grab a gun and use your special abilities to liberate the cattlepunk west!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -FEATURES- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

FUTA/INTERSEX: Lily is packing more than the average girl!

GUNS GALORE: Dozens of random possible gun enchantments!

CUSTOMIZATION: Scrap your loot to make your own guns!

FRONTIER NAVIGATION: An overworld map with encounters!
